text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. What types of vehicles should the system support?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - System must support extensible vehicle types like Sedans, SUVs, Hatchbacks etc.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. How should vehicle selection be handled when multiple options are available?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Booking should support multiple ways such as Cheapest first, Least Booked etc.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Will there be multiple ways to calculate rental charges?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes. (Hourly and DistanceBased, but it should be extensible)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Should the system support multiple payment methods?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, the system must be extendable to accommodate varios payment methods such as UPI, Credit Card, Cash, etc.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Should thee system allow adding new branches dynamically?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, we should be able to add/update/delete branched and vehicles

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Should each branch maintain its own vehicle inventory?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, Vehicles are registered under a specific branch.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Do I need to ensure that no two vehicles are booked simultaneously?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, the system should use proper locking mechanisms or synchronized access for renting vehicles.
